sentences.text: The Corruption and Crime Commission reviewed two WA Police investigations into allegations of excessive force by an officer.
sentences.support: The Commission conducted a review of the actions taken by WA Police into the two incidents of alleged excessive use of force

sentences.text: The Commission considered both investigations inadequate and their conclusions unsupported by adequate inquiries.
sentences.support: In the Commission's opinion, both investigations were inadequate and therefore the findings were not reasonably open.

sentences.text: The Commission made two recommendations about early support for officers at risk of misconduct and broader reporting of force to the head or neck.
sentences.support: The Commission has made two recommendations to WA Police:

sentences.text: WA Police rejected both recommendations, but the Commission retained them.
sentences.support: WA Police does not accept the two recommendations in this report.

notes: The report focuses on processes and uses pseudonyms. The summary uses roles and does not repeat the individual allegations.
